ok_wichita_mountains_wildlife_refuge.name: Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge
ok_wichita_mountains_wildlife_refuge.note: Sources say spring and fall are best, year-round possible, summer hot; no source names months

va_grayson_highlands_state_park.name: Grayson Highlands State Park
va_grayson_highlands_state_park.note: Sources conflict: summer called best (cool altitude), others mid-April to early June and late Sep to mid-Oct; no firm months from a climbing guide

co_unaweep_canyon.name: Unaweep Canyon
co_unaweep_canyon.note: Spring and fall named, no months given; Gateway, Cactus Park and Nine Mile Hill are different areas and co_unaweep_canyon_2 has a coordinate in another county

excluded.co_unaweep_canyon_2: coordinate far from the canyon, cannot tell what it is

ut_northern_wasatch.name: Northern Wasatch
ut_northern_wasatch.note: Too broad and varied (Bear Lake to Dock Flat, low crags to high peaks); no single window

co_estes_park_valley.name: Estes Park Valley
co_estes_park_valley.note: Only 'warmer months' and an April start at Lumpy Ridge; no months named and elevations vary widely

ma_lynn_woods.name: Lynn Woods
ma_lynn_woods.note: No source found naming a season; Mountain Project chart not readable as text
